canada.title: Via Rail heading back to Quebec’s Gaspé region after 15 years — a partial win that brings hope
canada.summary: Gaspé residents who have been waiting for the return of passenger train service since 2011 hope new federal investments and commitments from Via Rail will lead to full service resumption down the line.

canada.summary: What happens when senior staff in British Columbia municipalities suddenly disappear from their job? Often, a lot of silence.

canada.title: Weather in play once again when Ottawa visits Calgary for CPL final rematch
canada.summary: It may not be as visually striking as the famous snowy scenes from the 2025 Canadian Premier League final in Ottawa, but the 2026 final's rematch between Atlético and Cavalry will again see players battling the elements as well as each other.

canada.title: Structure fire closes streets surrounding Moncton restaurant
canada.summary: A structure fire in the area of St. George Street in Moncton has closed the surrounding area to traffic as firefighters on site continue to battle the flames.

canada.title: Could microrefineries help lower diesel prices in northern Canada?
canada.summary: A B.C. company is seeking federal support to build a business case for microrefineries that would convert natural gas into diesel and home heating fuels for communities across northern Canada.

canada.title: Medicine Hat releases review of suspected drowning of child at regional park
canada.summary: The City of Medicine Hat has released the findings of an independent review into the suspected drowning of an 11-year-old child during a field trip to Echo Dale Regional Park in June.

canada.title: Changing weather means Yellowknife is using more road salt than usual this year
canada.summary: Unpredictable freeze-thaw cycles have Yellowknife crews applying more road salt than usual this fall. City officials are also planning a public survey next month to ask residents how to prioritize clearing roads and trails.

canada.title: Winnipeggers book their tickets to Vice City with the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI

canada.title: New Brandon program restoring used medical equipment, keeping it out of landfills
canada.summary: Brandon's Mobility Renewal program restores donated medical equipment such as wheelchairs and walkers, offering them at 20 per cent of the retail price, or for volunteer hours, to keep items out of landfills.

canada.title: Holt Liberals show ‘lack of leadership’ on Dieppe school, PCs say
canada.summary: The opposition Progressive Conservatives are accusing the Holt government of paralysis on the thorny question of a proposed English-language school in Dieppe.

canada.title: Houston trip to NYC includes PM speech and energy meetings
canada.summary: Nova Scotia Premier Tim Houston is back in the United States for energy-related meetings, a face-to-face with the consul general of Canada in New York and to hear a speech by Prime Minister Mark Carney.

canada.title: These MUN scientists want your placentas, as they look for microplastics
canada.summary: Hundreds of pregnant people in Newfoundland and Labrador are donating their placentas — the organ that feeds a baby in the womb — so scientists at Memorial University can test them for microplastics.

canada.title: No physician assistants working in N.L. 3 years after province announced plan to hire 10
canada.summary: Legislation allowing the Newfoundland and Labrador College of Physicians and Surgeons to regulate physician assistants was adopted in 2025 but there are no physician assistants working in the province.
